claim: Software developer Chris Dzoba decided to try using AI to find the next largest diagram – one with 17 sets.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-06 - not yet checked by the human annotator] Dzoba, 'Simple symmetric Venn diagrams with 17 and 19 curves' (arXiv 2609.26546, 22 Sep 2026): the work was 'carried out by two AI systems working under the author's direction over five days'; certificates and a Lean 4 proof on GitHub. 17 is the next size after 13 (rotational symmetry needs a prime number of curves). 'Software developer' is not in the paper; a CreativeLive profile of a software engineer of the same name fits but was not confirmed to be him.
